The Saudi Civil Defense announced that it had responded to the fall of shrapnel from two ballistic missiles, including debris that landed in Sabuhah village. The missiles had been launched by the Houthi terrorist militia toward the Makkah region before being intercepted and destroyed, the Civil Defense said in a statement.
